decisions.reason: After four years the market signal for this incremental single-handle design should largely be known, and in a broad portfolio a design no longer visibly promoted is a natural candidate for pruning.
As another close-to-core handle design with limited strategic distinctiveness, its option value is now mostly exhausted and resources are better shifted to stronger lines or new development.

Despite the age of the launch, this electronic access system still fits the firm's digital system direction and retains platform value, so management would be more likely to keep or evolve it than withdraw it outright within the next year.
